description: Where ferries and other passenger vessels around Taiwan are right now (AIS): position, speed, course, status (under way, moored, ...) and the nearest port. Search by vessel name, near a port, or near a point. Positions are not tied to routes, and names are as the ships broadcast them (often English). Example: port "小琉球"; or keyword "TAIMA".

keyword.description: Part of the vessel name, e.g. "TAIMA" or "綠島之星".

lat.description: Latitude, to search near a point.

limit.description: Maximum number of vessels to return (default 20).

lon.description: Longitude, to search near a point.

moving.description: Only vessels under way (faster than 1 knot).

port.description: Only vessels near this port: name (基隆, 小琉球, 馬公) or port ID (TWKEL).

radiusKm.description: Search radius around the port or point, in km (default 10).

name: ferry_positions
title: Ferry positions
